decisions.reason: The source expands the graphic bullet visual-design scope across all templates but does not change Tab-driven hierarchy, indentation, or alignment behavior.
The style catalog already applies across the complete template set, and the source only clarifies the scope of the separate bullet visual-design requirement.
Applying the bullet-list design across all templates does not change the required default document language or resolve its existing ambiguity.
The source does not alter legacy-content paste behavior, stability constraints, or legacy test files.
The bullet-list visual-design scope change does not affect pasted-table structure or column containment.
The source does not change manual line-break behavior after pasted material.
The source changes neither the NXQ style prefix, its application condition, nor the language of style names.
The source does not change the supported Word environment or the general reliability and multi-user stability requirements.
